raw_response: {"diagnosis":"raw_transactions has 5124 rows but only 4975 distinct txn_id values, so overlapping batch deliveries re-send the same transactions. silver_transactions has no dedup step, so these rows reach silver and every gold table double-counts them. I did not see the duplicate rows, so I assumed the latest delivery (by ingest_ts, then batch_id) is the correct copy.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.6,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED'"}}
